summary: Ran a real, live, paired gateway-vs-direct-tool comparison across the frozen 7-entry corpus, with a genuinely new quality/completeness measurement axis no prior ticket had ever produced. Architecture Review caught two real, load-bearing Gate Integrity problems before implementation began: reusing Phase 1's proven source-comparison helper unmodified would have shipped a false provenance string into the new fixture, falsely claiming this ticket's own freshly-run data came from a Phase 0 historical fixture; and the plan's disclosed-subjective reviewer-judgment field had no concrete, falsifiable procedure constraining its content, meaning it could have been satisfied with content-free, templated judgments. Both fixed directly and independently re-verified exact on the second Review pass. The real, honest, unspun result: the gateway measured slower (1.31x-3.76x) and heavier in tokens (1.04x-2.93x) than direct tool use for all 7 of 7 corpus entries in this fresh, cold-cache run, with no entry excluded and no threshold redefined. Objective source-completeness showed the newly-closed Graphify half matching exactly on every routed entry, while hand-inspection of the Context-Search half's failures found 3 of 7 were real, narrow drops and 2 of 7 were normalization-shape false positives -- a claim Test phase later found was only ever stated in prose and added a real, mechanical test re-deriving it from the fixture's own data rather than trusting the claim. Hand-written, non-computed reviewer judgments, each citing a real, verbatim piece of retained evidence per entry, came out 6 of 7 favoring the direct tools, 1 of 7 mixed, and 0 of 7 favoring the gateway. This closes the fourth and final section 20 Phase 4 bullet in the proposal document -- all four Phase 4 deliverables now individually carry a real, evidenced Done annotation, though this ticket does not itself characterize Phase 4 as complete, which remains an explicit human-reviewer, epic-level call. All ACs and all 13 DoD conditions independently verified by done-checker in a single Verify pass, including four independently re-verified reviewer-judgment source citations traced back to the raw fixture data.
